commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90+3' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Rafa Mir (Valencia) was quite harsh and Alejandro Ruiz didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+2' Hugo Duro (Valencia) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Unai Simon comes off the line to clear the ball away.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
88' Unai Simon (Ath Bilbao) sends a long ball in, but Giorgi Mamardashvili comfortably gathers the ball.
84' Ivan Jaime (Valencia) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

83' Giorgi Mamardashvili pulls off a great save to deny Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
82' A substitution has been made. Jose Gaya is replaced by Fran Perez (Valencia).
82' Here comes a substitution. Maximillian Aarons (Valencia) is brought on as a substitute for Mouctar Diakhaby.
82' Ernesto Valverde decides to make a substitution. Gorka Guruzeta will be replaced by Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao).
80' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) is repeatedly being caught offside.
78' Unai Simon steps in and intercepts a long pass from Rafa Mir (Valencia).
77' Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) sends a long ball in, but Giorgi Mamardashvili comfortably gathers the ball.
75' Substitution. Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta will be replaced by Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao).
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Benat Prados Diaz trots off the pitch and is replaced by Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao).
74' Carlos Corberan has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Rafa Mir (Valencia) replacing Umar Sadiq.
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Hugo Duro (Valencia) comes onto the pitch so that Andre Almeida can be given a rest.

72' 0 - 1 What a hit that is! Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) displays his shooting ability as he slams the ball goalwards from distance. His brilliant effort goes towards the top right corner and bounces in off the post.
71' Luis Rioja (Valencia) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
69' Total attempts – 6:8. The current number of shots on goal is 2:2.
66' Luis Rioja (Valencia) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
64' It is time for a substitution. Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) is on for Adama Boiro.
64' Ernesto Valverde prepares a substitution. Oihan Sancet is replaced by Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao).
63' The flag goes up and the referee blows his whistle - another offside by Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao), who has already been caught several times today.
62' Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
61' The foul by Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) was seen by Alejandro Ruiz who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
59' The attendance for today's match is 45641.
58' Jose Gaya (Valencia) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
58' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Andre Almeida (Valencia). Valencia get a corner.
58' Referee Alejandro Ruiz sees the trip by Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
56' Carlos Corberan is forced to make a change. Diego Lopez is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Ivan Jaime (Valencia).
52' Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
52' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

49' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) meets a delivery on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the top of the net. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Giorgi Mamardashvili produces an easy save.

48' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) looks very eager to impress, does well to beat his man and force a cross into the box, where one of his teammates gets his head on the ball, but it's too easy for the keeper.
48' Adama Boiro (Ath Bilbao) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
46' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+1' What a great chance for Mouctar Diakhaby (Valencia). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header right under the bar, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save. Umar Sadiq (Valencia) covers his face with his hands after spurning a great chance. The ball rebounded to him but his close-range header went a whisker over the crossbar.
45+1' Andre Almeida (Valencia) takes the corner.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' An attempted cross from Diego Lopez (Valencia) is cleared. Valencia have been awarded a corner kick.
45' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner kick, but Giorgi Mamardashvili reads it well and stops the effort.

44' The free kick from the edge of the box is taken by Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao), but he hits it straight in the defensive wall. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao have been awarded a corner kick.
42' Jose Gaya (Valencia) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
42' Jose Gaya (Valencia) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Alejandro Ruiz blows for a foul. Ath Bilbao have a free kick from a promising distance.
41' The Ath Bilbao players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
39' Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
39' Corner kick. Andre Almeida (Valencia) is ready to send the ball into the box.
39' The ball is cleared after Umar Sadiq (Valencia) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play. Valencia are awarded a corner kick.
38' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) watches the ball all the way and connects well with a volley on the edge of the box, but sends the effort miles over the bar.
38' Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
36' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
35' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches over the top.
33' Here's the latest number of offsides – 1:3.
32' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
32' Andre Almeida (Valencia) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Javi Guerra, but Unai Simon displays great awareness to stop him.
31' Javi Guerra (Valencia) sends a long cross over to Umar Sadiq, but Unai Simon comes forward to gather the ball.
28' The referee blows for a cooling break.

28' This would have been a magnificent goal from Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao), who collected the ball inside the box and prodded a first-time shot on goal that flew just narrowly wide of the left post.
25' The total number of attempts is 2:2. The current number of shots on goal is 1:0.
23' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) sprays a pass out to Javi Guerra, but he can't beat his man inside the box.
21' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Giorgi Mamardashvili intercepts the ball.
21' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

20' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) receives a rebound and has a go from distance. His shot flies towards the goal, but is blocked at the last moment by a defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Ath Bilbao can continue in their attacking effort.
20' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
18' Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle and signals a foul after Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) brought his opponent down.
16' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Andre Almeida (Valencia), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
15' Adama Boiro (Ath Bilbao) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
14' A goal, which was scored by Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao), was disallowed due to offside.
13' Alejandro Ruiz blows for a foul after Andre Almeida (Valencia) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. That's a free kick to Ath Bilbao.
11' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
10' Luis Rioja (Valencia) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

10' Luis Rioja (Valencia) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the bottom right corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Unai Simon pulls off an easy save. Valencia win a corner.
8' Adama Boiro (Ath Bilbao) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
7' Diego Lopez (Valencia) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.
6' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Alejandro Ruiz stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.

5' Adama Boiro (Ath Bilbao) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) is furious with himself for wasting a glorious chance. He pounces on the rebound around the penalty spot and drags a shot well wide of the left post.
3' Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent.
2' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
1' The first half has just begun.
